purpose: Arbitrum One mainnet shielded pool: v1-protocol main 09ea1cb (same pool code + ceremony verifiers as Ethereum and HyperEVM 999), funds HyperCore sub-accounts over CCTP

roles.ownerNote: Hardware wallet, same owner as the Ethereum and HyperEVM 999 pools. The deployer holds no role.

revokers.note: Registered at deploy with the same keys as revoker 0 on the Ethereum and HyperEVM 999 pools (mainnet guardian committee). Used by transactions before 2026-11-20.

Registered by the owner ~2026-11-20 (tx 0x817cf27e8ac71a97c641f950a4ce5b7a89c5aaf6ae4567d52a799e6b6f1aaffd), new keys; the app transacts under it since veilnyx-hyperliquid #118 and it is to replace revoker 0.

periphery.note: Deployed from veilnyx-hyperliquid/protocol (not this repo); listed here so all Arbitrum One addresses are in one place.

depositForwarder.note: Gasless deposits: EIP-3009 USDC authorization + pool.transact in one call, submitted by the relayer. Immutable, no owner. feeRecipient = relayer 0x2FacDB45.

cctpHyperCoreFundingAdaptor.note: CALL_ADAPTOR target: funds a HyperCore sub-account over Circle CCTP (emits SubAccountFunded from the AdaptorHandler). Enabled on the pool (isAdaptorSupported = true). Immutable, no owner.

gasStationV2.note: UNUSED since the DepositForwarder (2026-11-17). Owner = hardware wallet; holds a 0.003 ETH float only the owner can withdraw.

relayer.note: Relayer and settle keeper (same key as the deployer).

notes: Pool, libraries and the nine verifiers are byte-identical to the build of v1-protocol main 09ea1cb (incl. metadata); verifiers are the Ethereum mainnet ceremony verifiers. Checked with script/arbitrum/verify-deployment.sh.
Arbiscan source verification is still pending (needs an Etherscan V2 API key).
